name: model-allowlist
description: Refuses a subagent spawn that names a pinned model id, and enforces your own per-agent-type model rules (for example, the strongest model only when the brief gives a reason)

refuse_pinned_ids.title: Refuse pinned model ids
refuse_pinned_ids.description: Refuse a subagent spawn whose model is anything but one of the allowed aliases below, such as a dated or versioned model id. Pinned ids go stale; a tier alias moves with the model line.

allowed_aliases.title: Allowed model aliases
allowed_aliases.description: The model names a spawn may use while pinned ids are refused. A trailing [..] such as opus[1m] is ignored when matching.

rules.title: Model rules
rules.description: One rule per entry, written: agent type pattern => model => brief pattern => message. When a spawn's agent type matches the first pattern and names that model (* for any model), the brief must match the brief pattern or the spawn is refused. An empty brief pattern always refuses. The message is optional and may use {type} and {model}. Patterns are case-insensitive regular expressions. Empty by default, so every model is allowed.
